description: This Java source file contains assertions for testing MongoDB index configurations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to verify that Mongo collections have the expected indices, ignoring defaults like the index on '_id' if specified.

classes.name: MongoIndexAssertions
classes.description: Provides static methods for asserting properties of MongoDB indices in tests, including comparison of actual and expected indices, with options to ignore default indices.

methods.name: assertIndices
methods.description: Main method to assert that a Mongo collection contains the expected indices, with an option to ignore the default index.

methods.name: assertIndices
methods.description: Internal method to compare the actual indices (obtained via supplier) with expected indices, after sorting.

methods.name: removeDefaultIndex
methods.description: Filters out the default '_id' index from a collection of indices.

methods.name: runBlocking
methods.description: Synchronously waits for a CompletionStage to complete, used for blocking on asynchronous MongoDB operations.
